## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio「权限解释」面板未选对象时，灰掉的「解释」和记录「选择」按钮，现在悬停、Tab 聚焦、读屏都能拿到原因「请先选择对象」。
- 为什么改：卡 #34865，与已关的 #32103/#32104/#32105 同类（`ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason`）。
- 风险与回滚：只改显示与可达性，复用已有共享包装 `DisabledControlReason`，未改它；禁用条件不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`AccessExplainPanel.tsx` 两处包装，`AccessExplainPanel.test.tsx` 末尾新 describe。
- 两分钟验证：跑 `AccessExplainPanel.test.tsx`，新增 2 条通过。
- 需要你做的：无，区内落地（非受管面、114 行）。L1 意见：可落；越出围栏的 i18n 两行已声明且必要。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-a) · repo:objectstack#5 · head `c35e3cc27e9e51554e953e5e68afe067dfed9b60` · 2026-11-19T02:43Z

- **形态:** draft → `main`, 5 files, +98/−16, 2 commits. `Fixes #34865` on its own line; no other card number sits beside a closing keyword (#32103–#32105 are named as closed precedents with no verb). `check-governed-merges --pr 35289`: 0 of 5 paths governed, 114 lines ≤ 3000 → ordinary queue landing. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` hold: no spec, exported prop or type changes; one new catalogue string.
- **Fixes vs the card:** the card names exactly two controls (Explain, Pick) and the missing reason on hover, focus and AT. Both are delivered on all three paths, so `Fixes` is right.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/34865-explain-access-disabled-reason.md`, `patch` on `@object-ui/i18n` (published) and `@object-ui/app-shell` (`private: true`, harmless). Sentences read against the diff: "no tooltip on hover, skipped by Tab, … Pick's only title was its own label" = the removed bare buttons and `title`; "the shared `DisabledControlReason` wrapper … a focusable wrapper … both the wrapper and the button point `aria-describedby` at it" = `_shared.tsx` lines 823–853, reused unchanged; "once an object is chosen both are plain enabled buttons" = `reason` undefined ⇒ no tabindex, no description, pinned by the control; "a running Explain gives no reason" = `busy ? undefined : needObjectReason`; "The new string is in the Studio namespace catalogues (`en`, `zh`)" = true, and the Studio namespace has only those two catalogues, so no locale is left without it.
- **接受的偏差:** (1) Fence: `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/en.ts` and `zh.ts` each gain one line outside the dispatch fence. The string has to live there, the PR body declares it, and the prior fixes of this class put theirs in the same place. Accepted. (2) Pick's `title` dropped: it repeated the visible label and would compete with the reason tooltip; pinned by `not.toHaveAttribute('title')`.
- **Pins:** new top-level describe in the existing harness. Positive: both disabled, each described by the reason, Pick has no `title`, Tab from the record id lands on Pick's wrapper then Explain's wrapper, each described, tooltip shows the reason. CONTROL: an object chosen ⇒ both enabled, no `aria-describedby`, no `data-disabled-reason`, no `tabindex` on the wrapper. No ablation was run; red-before is clear by reading (pre-fix the buttons carry no `aria-describedby`, so `describedBy()` returns null, and Pick carried `title`).
- **门禁:** check-runs on head `c35e3cc2`: 46 success, 15 skipped, 0 failure; one `Check Changeset` re-run from the body edit is in progress, and the earlier `Check Changeset` on this same head is success. Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Type Check UI and all 16 Test UI shards are success. Dev local: the app-shell vitest file and the UI type-check are NOT MEASURED (the shared verify lock was held); CI's `Test UI` and `Type Check UI` on this head cover both.
- **Nit, not blocking:** the PR body still lacks the trailing `🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)` line and the session link line. A body-only edit fixes it and needs no new push.
- **范围外去向:** none noticed.
- **落地条款:** K = 11 first-parent commits on `main` since merge base `f4dbcc21` (< 15), no locale pack. Non-governed ⇒ ux-1 lands per `landing-operations.md` (`pr_ready` + auto-merge) after this ACCEPT, once the in-progress `Check Changeset` re-run is green; on MERGED, close-out on #34865.
